key_insight: PhysRepair improves video realism by diagnosing the first physically invalid event in a generated clip and selectively repairing only the causally affected region with memory-guided in-context reasoning.
engineering_relevance: For solid mechanics video generation, the framework offers a practical way to preserve valid motion while correcting fracture or damage inconsistencies after synthesis instead of forcing overly constrained pre-generation prompts.
method: Detect the first invalid physical state and trace causally affected states.
Build a repair specification for localized, physically plausible regeneration.
Use experience-augmented in-context learning to adapt repairs from prior cases and accumulate repair trajectories.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluations on Physics-IQ Verified across solid mechanics and other physics domains, with consistent gains in physical plausibility over prior methods.
watch_item: The approach depends on reliable failure localization and prior repair experience, so difficult edge cases may still require careful human review or additional memory coverage.
paper_title: Agentic Physics-Grounded Video Generation via Memory-Augmented In-Context Reasoning
